consent_log_subject_check.name: consent_log_subject_check
consent_log_subject_check.value: case "consent_log"."subject_kind" when 'visitor' then "consent_log"."anonymous_id" is not null and "consent_log"."subject_ref" is null else "consent_log"."subject_ref" is not null end

media_asset_dimensions_check.name: media_asset_dimensions_check
media_asset_dimensions_check.value: ("media_asset"."width" is null and "media_asset"."height" is null) or ("media_asset"."width" > 0 and "media_asset"."height" > 0)

media_asset_image_dimensions_check.name: media_asset_image_dimensions_check
media_asset_image_dimensions_check.value: "media_asset"."mime" not like 'image/%' or "media_asset"."width" is not null

media_asset_reviewed_check.name: media_asset_reviewed_check
media_asset_reviewed_check.value: "media_asset"."review_state" <> 'approved' or ("media_asset"."reviewed_by" is not null and "media_asset"."reviewed_at" is not null)

order_line_subject_check.name: order_line_subject_check
order_line_subject_check.value: case "order_line"."kind" when 'product' then "order_line"."product_id" is not null and "order_line"."addon_id" is null when 'addon' then "order_line"."addon_id" is not null and "order_line"."product_id" is null else "order_line"."product_id" is null and "order_line"."addon_id" is null end

order_line_payout_check.name: order_line_payout_check
order_line_payout_check.value: ("order_line"."partner_payout_minor" is null) = ("order_line"."payout_currency_code" is null) and ("order_line"."partner_payout_minor" is null or "order_line"."partner_payout_minor" >= 0)

partner_coverage_target_check.name: partner_coverage_target_check
partner_coverage_target_check.value: "partner_coverage"."city_id" is not null or "partner_coverage"."postcode_zone_id" is not null
